# WG10 · Tài chính · đang tải dữ liệu

Group **WG · Tài chính PB02** · state · Next.js: **planned (U6)** (`/finance`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#html`
- Old web: `prototype/finance/finance.js#load`
- Finance PB02 is `prototype/finance/finance.js` (`PemaFinance.html()` + `mount(root)`), mounted inside the clinic shell; data comes from the Python API `finance_server.py` on 127.0.0.1:4174 with the headers `X-Pema-Role` and `X-Pema-Doctor`.
- `finance.js › html()` draws the shell with `<div id="content" aria-live="polite">Đang tải dữ liệu…</div>` and `mount()` calls `load()`; until the API answers the text stays. The header (title, month picker, "Làm mới") and the four tabs are already drawn.
- The reach holds every request to 127.0.0.1:4174 (route `hold`), so the page stays in this state. WG9 is the same page after the request fails (error line in `#error`).
- Inventory note: Finance API request pending: header, tabs and "Đang tải dữ liệu…" (WG9 is the same page after the request fails).
- Page key `finance` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"hold":"http://127.0.0.1:4174/**"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"finance\"]"} → {"wait":"#content"}; it must show "Đang tải dữ liệu…".

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<AppShell role="owner-tam">  // sidebar and top bar are the same on every page (WA1-WA3); active menu item "Tài chính & tiền thủ thuật", page key "finance"
  <Row gap="20px" justify="space-between">
    <Text small>"ĐIỀU HÀNH • PEMA CLINIC"</Text>
    <Heading level={1}>"Tài chính & tiền thủ thuật"</Heading>
    <Row old="tools" gap="12px" wrap>
      <Field label="Kỳ báo cáo" type="month" default="2026-09" id="month" />
      <Button variant="secondary">"Làm mới"</Button>
    </Row>
  </Row>
  <nav aria-label="Phân hệ tài chính" old="finance-tabs">
    <Tabs items={["Tổng quan","Tiền thủ thuật","Chính sách tỷ lệ","Phiếu thu & thông báo"]} selected="" />  // financeTab
  </nav>
  <Text>"Đang tải dữ liệu…"</Text>
</AppShell>
```
Kit components used: Field×1, Button×1, Tabs×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Business rules
- Revenue ("Doanh số thực hiện") follows the completion date of the procedure; cash ("Thực thu") follows the receipt date; they are tracked separately.
- "Tiền thủ thuật đã duyệt": "Không phải lợi nhuận phòng khám".
- "Đang tải dữ liệu…"

## Differences from the app design
- The app finance specs (H3–H9) have no loading state; only H7 "Mất kết nối" (error with "Thử lại"). The web loading text is a bare paragraph with no spinner and no retry control.

## Gotchas
- The tab content refreshes every 10 s (`setInterval`) unless an input has focus or the entry form is open; a pending form is never overwritten (`dirty` flag).
- Without the API the page shows "Chưa kết nối dữ liệu tài chính: <error>. Chạy python prototype/finance_server.py rồi thử lại." in `#error` (see WG9).
- The sync link of the topbar (`finance-bridge.js`) also reads "Đang đồng bộ tài chính…" in this state; it is outside the content scope of the snapshot.
